items.quote: This addon lets you generate an API key that allows you to send messages, reactions, and more via simple HTTP requests.
items.why: States API key generation only; says nothing about 'other' auth methods.

items.quote: The x-app-token/xpat token is the **App key** you receive when you create an app from scratch.
items.why: Identifies x-app-token as App key; doesn't list auth methods or api_key.
'Available on all plans' covers Free; no self-serve or any-member install detail.

items.quote: The full list of available actions is available in the Swagger documentation.
items.why: Points to full Swagger action list; says nothing about breadth being narrow.

items.quote: The rate limit is up to 1000 requests per minute per user.
items.why: Rate limit is a detail of the claim; doesn't support rest or narrow breadth.

items.quote: The list of available MCP tools is dynamic and depends entirely on the specific scopes you selected when creating an app.
items.why: Describes scope-dependent MCP tools; doesn't show server exists, vendor-official, or URL.
